content.user_title: Improve Developer Workflows and Project Tooling
content.value_statement: Slow setup and repetitive tasks reduce developer productivity. This skill reviews workflows and proposes measurable improvements to tooling, automation, documentation, and feedback loops.
actual_capabilities: Profiles current developer workflows to identify pain points and repeated manual tasks.
Recommends streamlined environment setup, intelligent defaults, and clearer error messages.
Proposes automation through project scripts, task runners, aliases, shortcuts, and Git hooks.
Suggests IDE settings, extensions, custom commands, and helpful development tool integrations.
Improves setup guides, inline command help, interactive examples, and troubleshooting documentation.
Defines metrics for onboarding time, eliminated steps, build speed, test speed, and developer satisfaction.
limitations: Provides guidance and proposed changes, but project-specific validation and testing remain required.
Cannot guarantee a five-minute onboarding target across every repository or environment.
Requires workflow details, constraints, permissions, and baseline measurements for accurate recommendations.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Accelerate New Project Setup
use_cases.description: Standardize onboarding, dependencies, defaults, and setup documentation for a new repository.

use_cases.title: Reduce Daily Development Friction
use_cases.description: Identify repeated tasks and improve build, test, reload, and command workflows.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Tooling Standards
use_cases.description: Create consistent hooks, IDE settings, task commands, and troubleshooting guidance across projects.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project setup and list the five highest-impact improvements for faster onboarding: [project details].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a focused assessment of an existing setup process.

prompt_templates.title: Remove Repetitive Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this workflow, identify repeated manual steps, and propose safe automation with verification criteria: [workflow].
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer wants to automate a frequent local task.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Feedback Loops
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess build, test, and hot reload performance using these measurements, then prioritize improvements by impact and effort: [measurements].
prompt_templates.scenario: A team has baseline timings and needs a prioritized optimization plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a DX Improvement Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased DX plan covering tooling, automation, documentation, adoption risks, metrics, owners, and validation: [team context].
prompt_templates.scenario: An engineering organization needs a coordinated improvement program.

output_examples.input: Our new developers need 45 minutes and nine manual steps to run the application.
output: Priority: automate dependency checks and local configuration setup.
Target: reduce onboarding to fewer than five documented steps.
Validation: test the guide with a developer using a clean machine.

output_examples.input: Tests take twelve minutes, but the team does not know which stage is slow.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: measure each test stage first, then prioritize the slowest repeatable stage and compare results against the baseline.

best_practices: Provide current workflow steps, measured timings, team constraints, and supported operating systems.
Apply changes incrementally and verify each improvement in a clean environment.
Track baseline and post-change metrics to confirm that improvements reduce real friction.
anti_patterns: Do not automate installation or configuration without confirming permissions and rollback requirements.
Do not add tools, hooks, or scripts without a clear maintenance owner and measurable benefit.
Do not optimize perceived friction without profiling the current workflow and gathering developer feedback.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide repository context, setup steps, workflow timings, pain points, constraints, permissions, and desired outcomes.

faq.question: Can this skill implement changes?
faq.answer: It can propose or implement project changes when the agent has repository access and appropriate permission.

faq.question: Can it automate dependency installation?
faq.answer: It may recommend or automate installation after permissions, platform constraints, and validation requirements are confirmed.

faq.question: How should improvements be measured?
faq.answer: Compare onboarding time, manual steps, build and test duration, feedback speed, and developer satisfaction before and after changes.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the package include the referenced playbook?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md references a playbook, but that file is not included in the published package.
